findings.reason: BAA history explicitly places the1897 start at Ashland and the move to Hopkinton in1924. The present Hopkinton start therefore preceded2004 by80years, not more than a century. A century of the Hopkinton start now exists but does not establish that every detail of the route was unchanged. Keep race founded1897 and longstanding point-to-point identity; correct specific route dates and unchanged claims.9.5 may keep1897 for the race identity if distinguished from the specific start.

patch.before_zh: 波士顿落在了线外。它量得准，可是它的几何，那个从1897年就定下的，从霍普金顿到波士顿的点对点路线，让它必然通不过百分之五十和每公里一米这两个测试。而波士顿这条路线，比这条线本身早了一个多世纪。它不是为了违反这条线而设计的，它被设计出来的时候，这条线还不存在。是这条线后来划过来，把它划到了外面。
patch.after_zh: 波士顿落在了线外。它量得准，可是它的几何——从霍普金顿通向波士顿的点对点路线——通不过百分之五十和每公里一米这两个测试。赛事创办于1897年，最初从阿什兰出发；1924年起点才移到霍普金顿。这个沿用已久的点对点格局，仍比2004年生效的世界纪录框架早了几十年。它不是为了规避后来那套标准而设计的；是后来的纪录条件，把这场老比赛放在了那一栏之外。
patch.before_en: Boston fell outside. It is accurately measured, but its geometry, that point-to-point route from Hopkinton to Boston established in 1897, necessarily fails the 50-percent and one-metre-per-kilometre tests. The route predates the boundary by more than a century. It was not designed to violate it. When the route was designed, the boundary did not exist. The line arrived later and placed Boston outside.
patch.after_en: Boston fell outside. It is accurately measured, but the geometry of its point-to-point course from Hopkinton to Boston fails the 50-percent and one-metre-per-kilometre tests. The race began in 1897 with a start in Ashland; the start moved to Hopkinton in 1924. This long-established point-to-point arrangement still predates the world-record framework effective in 2004 by decades. It was not designed to evade those later standards. The record conditions subsequently placed the old race outside that column.

echo_fields.before_zh: 这段历史，正好是这一篇主题的一个时间维度。世界纪录这个类别，在路跑上，不是一直存在的。它是2004年才被建立起来的。而建立它，必须先划一条线，划出赛道的丈量标准和几何标准。在这条线被划出来之前，路跑只有世界最好，一个不依赖赛道几何的，更宽松的说法。这条线一划，路跑就有了世界纪录，一个依赖赛道几何的，更严格的类别。而波士顿，因为它1897年就有的点对点身份，比这个2004年才建立的纪录架构，早了一个多世纪。
echo_fields.before_en: This history adds a temporal dimension to the essay's subject. The world-record category has not always existed in road running. It was established in 2004. Establishing it first required a boundary defining measurement and geometrical standards. Before that boundary, road running had world bests, a broader designation not dependent on course geometry. Once it was drawn, road running had world records, a stricter category dependent on geometry. Boston's point-to-point identity, dating from 1897, preceded this record framework, established only in 2004, by more than a century.

echo_fields.before_zh: 这个构能划一条线，把那些几何上过度帮忙的赛道，挡在世界纪录之外，从而让世界纪录这一栏里的成绩，可以彼此比较。它没有办法用这一条线，衡量出波士顿的全部分量。因为波士顿的分量，一部分在世界纪录这套账里量不出来，它在另一套账里，在那条一百多年没有改过的，从霍普金顿到波士顿的路线里，在每一个知道这条路线有多难的人心里。构划的那条线，是真实的，有用的，它让一种比较成为可能。而它划不进去的那些东西，也是真实的，它们只是在另一套账上。
echo_fields.before_en: The construct can draw a boundary excluding courses whose geometry offers excessive assistance, making performances within the world-record column comparable to one another. It cannot use that boundary to measure Boston's entire weight. Part of Boston's significance cannot be measured in the world-record ledger. It lies in another ledger, in the route from Hopkinton to Boston unchanged for more than a century, in the minds of everyone who knows how difficult that route is. The construct's boundary is real and useful. It makes one kind of comparison possible. What it cannot enclose is also real. Those things simply belong to another ledger.

findings.reason: OfficialWA20April2026 report and BAA2026 results give JohnKorir2:01:52, surpassing Mutai2:03:02. Retain Mutai historical2011 fastest-at-the-time and then-course-record status, not today/current/retains as the record.10.8 can simply say former course record or record achieved then; no need add a distracting new athlete story there.

patch.before_zh: 它没有被判为无效，也没有人说穆塔伊做错了什么。波士顿田径协会今天仍然把这个两小时三分零二秒，郑重地列为它的赛道纪录。它只是不是世界纪录。
patch.after_zh: 它没有被判为无效，也没有人说穆塔伊做错了什么。波士顿田径协会把这两小时三分零二秒保存在比赛历史中：那是2011年创造的赛道纪录，直到2026年才被约翰·科里尔的两小时一分五十二秒打破。穆塔伊的成绩仍然有效，只是不是世界纪录。
patch.before_en: The performance was not declared invalid, and nobody said that Mutai had done anything wrong. The Boston Athletic Association still gives that 2:03:02 its full due as the course record. It simply is not a world record.
patch.after_en: It was not declared invalid, and no one said Mutai had done anything wrong. The Boston Athletic Association preserves 2:03:02 in the race’s history: it was the course record set in 2011, finally surpassed by John Korir’s 2:01:52 in 2026. Mutai’s performance remains valid; it simply was not a world record.

echo_fields.before_zh: 第三个，穆塔伊的两小时三分零二秒被判无效。裁决要窄得多，它只是不能被批准为世界纪录。国际田联承认了它空前的速度，波士顿田径协会至今保存它作为赛道纪录，没有任何针对穆塔伊的不当行为裁决。
echo_fields.before_en: Third: Mutai's 2:03:02 was declared invalid. The ruling was much narrower: it could not be ratified as a world record. The IAAF acknowledged its unprecedented speed, the Boston Athletic Association retains it as the course record, and there was no finding of misconduct against Mutai.

echo_fields.before_zh: 这是这一篇最要紧的一点。一个成绩被划到世界纪录之外，不等于它被减损了。穆塔伊那个两小时三分零二秒，仍然是那一刻跑过的最快马拉松，这个事实，不因为它进不了世界纪录而改变。世界田径自己说，这丝毫无损于这个成绩。而波士顿田径协会，用另一套账来保存波士顿:赛道纪录，冠军，连续性，难度，历史。它没有为了进世界纪录那一栏，去重新设计那条传奇的路线。它把那条路线，连同穆塔伊的赛道纪录，连同它作为世界上最古老的年度马拉松的地位，一起保存在了另一套账里。
echo_fields.before_en: That is the essay's essential point. Placing a performance outside world records does not diminish it. Mutai's 2:03:02 remained the fastest marathon run up to that moment. Its ineligibility for a world record does not change that fact. World Athletics itself says that exclusion takes nothing away from the achievement. The Boston Athletic Association preserves Boston in another ledger: course records, champions, continuity, difficulty, history. It has not redesigned the legendary route to gain entry to the world-record column. It has preserved the route, Mutai's course record and its status as the world's oldest annual marathon together in another set of accounts.

findings.kind: source measurement requirement versus intrinsic universal uncertainty
findings.reason: Official manual distinguishes required measurement uncertainty not exceeding0.1% from the1.001 prevention factor. It does not establish that each calibrated-bicycle measurement has exactly0.1% irreducible uncertainty, nor that the factor makes every conceivable measurement error harmless. Preserve42.195m buffer arithmetic and3.5’s explicit not-exact-physical-length caveat. In3.5 say reduce short-course risk, not universal guarantee or harmless to all runners.2.8 final every-factor-blocked also needs reduction rather than total elimination.

patch.before_zh: 标定自行车这个方法，有一个已知的精度极限:它的不确定性大约是千分之一。也就是说，量一条四十二公里的赛道，可能有几十米的误差。
patch.after_zh: 赛道丈量并不是没有误差。国际田联的路跑手册把相关比赛的丈量不确定度要求限制在千分之一以内，马拉松约对应四十二米的量级。这是对丈量质量的要求，不是说每次标定自行车测量都必然有恰好千分之一的误差，更不是一个无法改进的自然极限。
patch.before_en: The calibrated-bicycle method has a known precision limit: its uncertainty is approximately one part in a thousand. In measuring a course of forty-two kilometres, the error may therefore amount to several dozen metres.
patch.after_en: Course measurement is not error-free. The IAAF road-running manual requires measurement uncertainty in the relevant competitions not to exceed one part in a thousand, about 42 metres over a marathon. That is a requirement for measurement quality, not a claim that every calibrated-bicycle measurement necessarily has exactly that uncertainty or that this is an irreducible natural limit.

echo_fields.before_zh: 这不是说每一条认证的马拉松，都被断言物理上恰好是四十二点二三七一九五公里长。它是一个计量上的安全系数。它做的事情，是故意把误差推到无害的那一侧。因为测量总有千分之一的不确定，那么与其冒一条赛道实际偏短的风险，不如故意把它量得稍微长一点。宁可长一点，也不可短一点。长一点，运动员只是多跑了几十米，无伤大雅；短一点，成绩就建立在一条不合格的赛道上，纪录就不成立。
echo_fields.before_en: This does not mean that every certified marathon is asserted to be physically exactly 42.237195 kilometres long. It is a metrological safety factor. It deliberately pushes error towards the harmless side. Since measurement carries uncertainty of one part in a thousand, it is better to measure the course slightly long than risk making it short. Better a little long than a little short. A slightly long course merely makes athletes run a few dozen extra metres, without undermining the record; a short course places the performance on a course of insufficient length, and the record cannot stand.

echo_fields.before_zh: 最短可能路线这个规矩，背后有一个和整个丈量方法一致的谨慎。它假设的，是一个会把每一个合法便宜都占尽的运动员，而不是一个老老实实沿路中间跑的运动员。为什么要按最坏的情况来量。因为纪录要防的，恰恰是那个占尽便宜的人:如果赛道是按路中心线量的四十二点一九五公里，而一个运动员切了每一个弯，他实际跑的就短于四十二点一九五公里，他的纪录就建立在一段不足的距离上。所以构不按平均的跑者来量，按那个能把路线跑到最短的跑者来量。它量的不是大多数人会跑多远，是最少可能跑多远。这和短程预防系数是同一个方向的谨慎，都是把每一个可能让赛道偏短的因素，提前堵死。
echo_fields.before_en: Behind the shortest-possible-route rule lies the same caution as in the measurement method as a whole. It assumes an athlete who takes every lawful advantage, rather than one who dutifully runs down the middle of the road. Why measure for the worst case? Because the record must guard against precisely the runner who takes every advantage. If a course measures 42.195 kilometres along the road's centre, a runner who cuts every corner runs less than 42.195 kilometres, and the record rests on an insufficient distance. The construct therefore measures for the runner who can make the route shortest, not for the average runner. It measures the least distance anyone could run, not the distance most people will run. This caution points in the same direction as the short-course prevention factor: both close off, in advance, every factor that could make the course too short.

findings.reason: Opening no absolute standard can read as rejecting any length standard although2.3 expressly uses a steel-tape calibration course. Its valuable claim is that nominal tyre diameter and a once-for-all calibration do not replace repeated calibration. Do not expand this into a philosophical rewrite or claim traceability proves metaphysical certainty.

patch.before_zh: 这是一个不相信任何绝对标准的方法。它不相信车轮的名义直径，不相信一次标定的结果能永远有效，它只相信反复的，就在测量现场做的经验校准。构要制造一条可比的长度，靠的不是一把一劳永逸的尺子，而是每一次都重新校准的，对当下条件的经验测定。这正是这个系列一直在讲的东西的一个很具体的样子:可比性不是一个现成的东西，是一套不断校准出来的东西。
patch.after_zh: 这个方法不把车轮的名义直径，也不把一次标定的结果，当成一劳永逸的答案。它先借助经过丈量的标定路段，再反复在现场检查计数与距离的关系。构要制造一条可比的长度，靠的不是一把永远不必复核的尺子，而是把共同的长度标准和当下条件下的经验校准接起来。这正是这个系列一直在讲的东西的一个很具体的样子：可比性不是一个现成的东西，是一套不断校准出来的东西。
patch.before_en: This is a method that trusts no absolute standard. It trusts neither the nominal wheel diameter nor the idea that one calibration remains valid forever. It trusts repeated empirical calibration at the place of measurement. To produce a comparable length, the construct relies not on a ruler settled once and for all, but on an empirical determination of present conditions, calibrated afresh each time. This is a particularly concrete instance of what this series has been describing: comparability is not something ready-made. It is something continually produced through calibration.
patch.after_en: The method does not treat a wheel’s nominal diameter, or one calibration, as an answer valid for all time. It starts from a measured calibration course and repeatedly checks the relation between counts and distance under local conditions. A comparable length depends not on a ruler that never needs checking, but on connecting a shared length standard with empirical calibration in present conditions. It is a concrete instance of this series’ recurring theme: comparability is not simply given. It is continually calibrated.

findings.reason: Different wind along42km prevents a single short-event-style reading from representing the whole competitive exposure; it does not mean meaningful wind measurements are impossible. Geometry limits opportunity for sustained one-direction assistance, not guarantees zero wind advantage. Keep7.6’s already-correct weather-not-standardised-away qualification.10.2 should describe proxy limitation, not a guaranteed controlled tailwind range.

patch.before_zh: 这里可以看到路跑和短跑在同一个问题上的不同做法，而这个不同本身很说明问题。短跑防顺风，用的是一个直接测量的风速，超过加二点零米每秒就不算。这条线也是切出来的，二点零和二点一之间没有生理的悬崖。可是短跑至少能直接测那个风。路跑没法在四十二公里的整条赛道上，测一个有意义的风速，因为不同路段的风向风力都不一样。所以路跑退而求其次，不去测那个测不了的风，而去限制赛道的几何，让顺风没有机会在一段长直线上系统性地帮忙。同一个防顺风的目的，短跑用测量，路跑用几何，因为路跑那个要测的东西，测不了。构选择规范什么，一部分取决于什么是它能测，能控制的。
patch.after_zh: 这里可以看到路跑和短跑在同一个问题上的不同做法。短跑的纪录资格使用直接测得的风速，加二点零米每秒是一条明确的线；二点零和二点一之间并没有生理的悬崖。路跑沿途当然也能测风，可是四十二公里上不同路段、不同时间的风向风力，不能用一次短时读数代表。于是路跑纪录不照搬短跑那一套，而用赛道几何作一层代理限制，减少一条长直线持续借助顺风的机会。这没有把天气影响消掉。同一个可比性问题，短跑主要用规定时段的风速读数，路跑则部分借助几何条件。构选择规范什么，也受测量与执行条件的影响。
patch.before_en: Here we can see road racing and sprinting address the same problem differently, and the difference is revealing. Sprinting guards against tailwind assistance by measuring wind speed directly: above +2.0 metres per second, a performance cannot count as a record. That line is also a cut; there is no physiological cliff between 2.0 and 2.1. But sprinting can at least measure the wind directly. Road racing cannot measure one meaningful wind speed for an entire forty-two-kilometre course, because wind direction and strength vary along it. It settles for another approach. Rather than measuring wind that cannot meaningfully be measured in that way, it restricts the course's geometry, preventing a tailwind from systematically assisting runners along one long straight journey. With the same aim of limiting tailwind assistance, sprinting uses measurement and road racing uses geometry, because road racing cannot measure the relevant thing directly. What the construct chooses to regulate depends partly on what it can measure and control.
patch.after_en: Road running and sprinting take different approaches to the same problem. Sprint-record eligibility uses a direct wind reading and a clear line at+2.0 metres per second; there is no physiological cliff between 2.0 and 2.1. Wind can of course be measured along a road course too. But one brief reading cannot represent changing directions and strengths across 42 kilometres and an entire race. Road-record rules therefore do not copy the sprint procedure. They use course geometry as a proxy restriction, reducing the opportunity for sustained assistance along one long line. This does not remove the effects of weather. Sprinting mainly uses wind measured over a specified interval; road running partly relies on geometry. What a construct regulates is also shaped by conditions of measurement and implementation.

echo_fields.before_zh: 世界田径必须先划一条线，才能在2004年，把路跑的世界最好，变成可以批准的世界纪录。这条线，让世界纪录这个统计类别，更可复现，更可比。一条赛道要进这个类别，必须量得准，必须几何合格，必须计时用枪声的时钟。这些要求，把那些系统性影响成绩的因素，坡度，顺风，起点终点的相对位置，都限制在了一个可控的范围里。
echo_fields.before_en: World Athletics had to draw a boundary before road-running world bests could become ratifiable world records in 2004. That boundary made the statistical category of world records more reproducible and comparable. A course entering the category must be accurately measured, geometrically eligible and timed by the gun's clock. Those requirements confine factors that systematically affect performance, including slope, tailwind and the relative positions of start and finish, within a controllable range.

findings.kind: source repeated archival absence / cross-essay regression
findings.reason: Keep previously acceptedEP07/12 distinctions: no complete located published quantitative derivation of every coefficient/40mm is not no research, no reasons or never a derivation.14/16 references must match their later reviewed versions rather than restart categorical physiology claims. Numerical conventions remain defensible, not uniquely physiologically compelled.

patch.before_zh: 所以这两条线，和这个系列前面那些线，是同一种东西。第七篇里，十项全能计分表的系数，没有公开推导。第十二篇里，跑鞋的四十毫米，没有推导。第十四篇里，睾酮的阈值，不是从效应量算出来的。第十六篇里，起跑的零点一零零秒，不是一个稳定的生理常数。现在是这一篇，百分之五十和每公里一米，同样不是从生理里读出来的。它们是可辩护的标准化阈值，为了可复现的可比性而选定，而不是人类生理的常数。
patch.after_zh: 所以这两条线，和前面几篇讨论的边界有相近之处。第七篇里，查到的计分材料没有交出每一个系数的完整推导；第十二篇里，四十毫米有公开的政策理由，但没有找到一个把它唯一算出来的定量过程。第十四篇讨论比赛资格条件，第十六篇讨论零点一零零秒警戒线，都不能把一条制度边界直接当成对每个身体通用的生理常数。现在的百分之五十和每公里一米，也是一组为了可比性而制定、可以解释和辩护的规则，不是从人体里直接读出的常数。
patch.before_en: These boundaries are therefore the same kind of thing as earlier boundaries in this series. In Essay 7, the coefficients of the decathlon scoring tables lacked a public derivation. In Essay 12, the forty-millimetre shoe limit lacked a derivation. In Essay 14, the testosterone threshold was not calculated from an effect size. In Essay 16, the 0.100-second start threshold was not a stable physiological constant. Here, too, 50 percent and one metre per kilometre are not numbers read out of physiology. They are defensible standardisation thresholds, selected to produce reproducible comparability, not constants of human physiology.
patch.after_en: These two lines resemble boundaries discussed earlier in the series. In Essay 7, the scoring material located did not supply a complete derivation of every coefficient. In Essay 12,40 millimetres had public policy reasons, but no quantitative procedure uniquely deriving that number was found. Essay 14’s eligibility conditions and Essay 16’s 0.100-second warning threshold likewise cannot simply be treated as physiological constants applying to every body. The 50-percent and one-metre-per-kilometre limits are also explainable, defensible rules adopted for comparability, not constants read directly from human physiology.

findings.kind: source universalisation / evidence versus normative uniqueness
findings.reason: Local slope/separation variables are continuous. This does not establish almost every construct has a continuous variable or that no uniquely defensible optimum could exist for a specified decision objective. As already acceptedEP12, no uniquely compelled answer from physiology alone is not no reasons or arbitrary. Scope the thesis to these thresholds, preserving the author’s philosophical argument.

patch.before_zh: 这几条线合起来，说明了一件关于构的普遍的事。构要制造可比性，就必须划线。而它要划的那条线，几乎总是划在一个连续的，没有自然断点的量上。坡度是连续的，间距是连续的，于是任何一条具体的线，都必然是切出来的，可以被解释，可以被辩护，但无法被证明它切在了那个唯一正确的位置上，因为那个位置不存在。构不是先找到了自然的边界再划线，是它必须划线，然后在一个没有边界的地方，切了一条。
patch.after_zh: 把这几条线放在一起，可以看清这一类可比性规则怎样工作。坡度和起终点间距都是连续的量，数据能帮助我们判断差异有多大，却不会单靠自己宣布应该把哪些成绩放在同一栏。具体的阈值仍要联系比较的目的、可接受的差异与执行条件来选择。它可以被解释，也可以被辩护；这里没有找到一个仅凭生理数据就能唯一推出百分之五十或每公里一米的过程。构不是没有理由地划线，而是要把关于差异的证据，接到关于怎样比较的判断上。
patch.before_en: Together, these lines reveal something general about the construct. To produce comparability, it must draw a boundary. Almost invariably, it must draw that boundary across a continuous quantity with no natural break. Gradient is continuous; separation is continuous. Any particular line must therefore be a cut. It can be explained and defended, but cannot be proved to occupy the uniquely correct position, because that position does not exist. The construct does not first discover a natural boundary and then mark it. It has to draw a line, and makes a cut where there was no boundary.
patch.after_en: Together, these lines show how this kind of comparability rule works. Slope and start–finish separation are continuous quantities. Data can help establish the size of differences, but do not by themselves announce which performances should share a column. A threshold must also be chosen in relation to the purpose of comparison, acceptable differences and practical enforcement. It can be explained and defended. No procedure was found here that uniquely derives 50 percent or one metre per kilometre from physiology alone. The construct does not draw a line without reasons. It connects evidence about differences with a judgement about how to compare.

findings.reason: 9November2011 official announcement grandfathered existing mixed records but allowed new WR only in women-only races. Parallel mixed/women-only new-record categories became effective1November2013 (2013Congress official report and2015official progression history). Do not telescope grandfathering into immediate dual ongoing recognition. Preserve2011AIMS/WMMopposition and Radcliffe2003record retained.

patch.before_zh: 国际田联退让了。2011年11月，在摩纳哥的理事会会议上，它从那个单一账本的方案后退，恢复了对混合比赛成绩的承认，最终产生了今天还在用的平行类别结构。拉德克利夫的两小时十五分二十五秒，保留了世界纪录的承认，而不是被永久降为一个世界最好。
patch.after_zh: 国际田联后来分两步调整。2011年11月，摩纳哥理事会保留了既有女子路跑世界纪录，包括在混合比赛中创造的纪录，但当时仍规定，新的纪录只能在纯女子比赛中产生。拉德克利夫的两小时十五分二十五秒因此没有被永久降格。直到2013年11月1日起，规则才正式并列承认混合与纯女子比赛的两类世界纪录，形成今天沿用的平行结构。
patch.before_en: The IAAF stepped back. At its Council meeting in Monaco in November 2011, it retreated from the single-ledger proposal and restored recognition of mixed-race performances, ultimately producing the parallel categories still used today. Radcliffe's 2:15:25 retained world-record recognition rather than being permanently downgraded to a world best.
patch.after_en: The IAAF subsequently adjusted its position in two stages. In November 2011, its Monaco Council retained existing women’s road world records, including those achieved in mixed races, but still allowed new records only in women-only races. Radcliffe’s 2:15:25 was therefore not permanently downgraded. Separate recognition of world records achieved in mixed and women-only races took effect on 1 November 2013, establishing the parallel structure used today.

findings.kind: source dispute misidentified / institutional choice not absence of reasons
findings.reason: Both proposals already classified mixed versus women-only: one WR+one best versus two WR categories. Dispute was status and continuing recognition of mixed performances, not whether any category boundary should be drawn.6.10’s not an objective principle also needs no uniquely compelled answer rather than no objective reasons; official2011fair-play rationale and AIMSreasons exist. Keep physical drafting evidence distinct from a unique observed Radcliffe counterfactual.

patch.before_zh: 而这里的争论，和跑鞋那一篇是同一种结构。跟在别人后面能减少空气阻力，改善跑步经济性，这个物理事实不是争议的部分。有争议的那一步，是把跟跑和配速这个连续的情形，变成一个基于比赛性别构成的，非此即彼的分类。建模没有测量拉德克利夫2003年到底得到了多少帮助，也不能确立她在一场纯女子比赛里的反事实成绩会是多少。所以主张两个类别的一方，和最初主张一个类别的国际田联，都承认条件不同，他们分歧的是，要不要把这个不同，固化成一条分类的线。
patch.after_zh: 而这里的争论，和跑鞋那一篇有相近的结构。跟跑能减少空气阻力、改善跑步经济性，这不是争论的全部。有争议的是，这种比赛条件差异应当怎样进入纪录簿。现有模型不能单独给出拉德克利夫2003年在纯女子比赛中会跑出多少的确定答案。国际田联当初的“纯女子世界纪录加混合比赛世界最好”，和反对者主张的“两类世界纪录”，其实都区分了条件；双方争的是混合比赛成绩应得到什么地位，以及未来能否继续在那一栏创造世界纪录。
patch.before_en: The dispute has the same structure as the one in the essay on shoes. The physical fact that following another runner can reduce aerodynamic drag and improve running economy is not the disputed part. The contested step turns the continuous circumstances of drafting and pacing into a binary classification based on the race's sex composition. Modelling has not measured how much assistance Radcliffe actually received in 2003, nor can it establish her counterfactual performance in a women-only race. Both the advocates of two categories and the IAAF, initially advocating one, therefore recognised a difference in conditions. They disagreed over whether that difference should be fixed into a classificatory boundary.
patch.after_en: The dispute has a structure resembling the shoe debate. Drafting can reduce air resistance and improve running economy, but that physical point does not settle how the difference should enter the record book. Existing models do not by themselves establish a definite women-only counterfactual time for Radcliffe in 2003. The IAAF’s initial proposal—women-only world records plus mixed-race world bests—and the opposing proposal of two world-record categories both distinguished the conditions. They disagreed about the status mixed-race performances should receive, and whether future performances could continue to establish world records in that column.

echo_fields.before_zh: 这场争论的结局，也很有意思。国际田联最初想用一套账，就是只认纯女子纪录；反对者想用两套账，混合和纯女子各记各的。最后胜出的是两套账。这个结局，恰好和跑鞋那一篇里的选择遥相呼应，只是方向相反。跑鞋那里，构面对新旧器械，选择了保留在同一套账里，不分。这里，构面对混合和纯女子，最终选择了分成两套账。同样是面对一个条件的差异，构一次选择合并，一次选择分开。而决定它选哪一种的，不是一个客观的原则，是各方的博弈，和对什么样的纪录簿更能代表这项运动的判断。构在这些地方的选择，从来不是被证据逼出来的唯一答案，是在几个都站得住的选项里，挑一个。
echo_fields.before_en: The outcome is also instructive. The IAAF initially wanted one ledger, recognising only women-only records; its opponents wanted two, recording mixed and women-only races separately. Two ledgers prevailed. This echoes the choice in the shoe essay, but in the opposite direction. There, confronted with old and new equipment, the construct chose to retain one ledger without separation. Here, confronted with mixed and women-only races, it eventually chose two. Faced with a difference in conditions, it chose merger on one occasion and separation on another. What determined the choice was not an objective principle, but the contest among interested parties and their judgement of which kind of record book would better represent the sport. Such choices are never the single answer compelled by the evidence. They select one among several defensible options.

findings.kind: source unsupported institutional motive / uncontrollability not unregulability
findings.reason: Previous paragraph explicitly says original temperature-rationale decision not found. This paragraph then gives an asserted because uncontrollable motive. Physical inability to change altitude/weather does not prevent classification or eligibility regulation (acceptedEP05/11). Preserve possible structural interpretation, clearly label it as inference and avoid blanket more-important-than timing claim.

patch.before_zh: 而这个选择本身，接得上这个系列很早的一篇。第五篇里讲过，1976年国际田联规范了计时，一个可控的东西，而没有规范海拔，一个更要紧的东西，构倾向于规范它能控制的，而不是它最该控制的。这里是一个相近的情形。风和温度对成绩的影响，科学上是确凿的。那项波士顿的研究就发现，气温升高时成绩变差，风向和成绩的变化相关。可是构没有直接去规范风和温度，因为它们是比赛当天的，不可控的天气。它转而去规范赛道的几何，一个在赛道设计时就可以确定的，可控的东西。
patch.after_zh: 这个结果可以和第五篇放在一起看，但不能替机构补出一份没有找到的动机说明。机构不能改变海拔或当天的天气，仍然可以决定怎样标注、分类或认定这些条件下的成绩。波士顿研究显示，气温与风向同成绩相关；规则在纪录资格上直接限制赛道几何，却没有给路跑设置一条照搬短跑的风速上限，也没有设置一条温度纪录线。几何在设计与认证阶段较容易统一执行，这可以作为理解规则的一种解释，但不能当成已经证实的唯一决策原因。
patch.before_en: This choice connects with an early essay in the series. Essay 5 described how, in 1976, the IAAF regulated timing, something controllable, rather than altitude, something more consequential. The construct tends to regulate what it can control rather than what most needs controlling. Here we have a similar situation. The effects of wind and temperature on performance are scientifically established. The Boston study found that performances worsened as temperatures rose and that wind direction was associated with changes in performance. Yet the construct has not directly regulated wind and temperature, which are uncontrollable race-day weather. It has turned instead to course geometry, something controllable and determinable at the design stage.
patch.after_en: This outcome can be read alongside Essay 5, without supplying the institution with a motive statement that has not been found. Officials cannot change altitude or the weather on race day, but they can still classify, annotate or determine the eligibility of performances under those conditions. The Boston research associates temperature and wind direction with results. Record rules directly restrict course geometry without copying sprinting’s wind ceiling or setting a road-record temperature threshold. Geometry is more readily standardised at design and certification. That offers one possible interpretation of the rules, not a demonstrated exclusive reason for the decision.

findings.kind: source false consequence / unverified exclusive motive
findings.reason: Net timing removes waiting-to-cross from the clock, not the physical effects of congestion or starting position; front and back therefore do not become equivalent. Official rule establishes gun time, not an exclusive philosophical motive of deliberately sacrificing fairness. Keep author’s reading as an interpretation, not alleged institutional awareness/intention. Gun time preserves common race reference and order; starting waves should not be conflated into literally one gunshot for every participant.

patch.before_zh: 这套区分之所以要讲，是因为它纠正一个很自然的直觉。一个大众跑者会觉得，我明明是枪响几分钟后才过的起跑线，凭什么用枪响的时间算我。对他个人来说，净时间当然更公平，那才是他真正跑了多久。可是纪录用的是枪响的时钟，不是因为它对个人更公平，恰恰相反，它对个人不公平。它用枪响的时钟，是因为纪录要的是一个统一的，对所有人一样的起点。如果每个人从自己过线的那一刻开始算，那么起跑线上的位置就不再重要，抢在前面和挤在后面就没有区别了，而这会改变比赛的一部分性质。所以纪录牺牲了对个人的公平，换取了一个统一的时钟。这又是构的一个取舍:它知道净时间对个人更公平，可是它为了纪录的统一，选择了那个不那么个人公平的枪声时钟。
patch.after_zh: 这套区分纠正了一个自然的直觉。大众跑者会问：我几分钟以后才过起点，为什么把等待也算进来？净时间更接近他自己从起点跑到终点的用时，但它不会消除后排出发的拥挤和绕行。纪录采用枪声时间，使同一场比赛的计时依照共同的发令参照，而不是各自过线时另开一只钟。这可以理解为一种取舍：个人实际覆盖赛程的用时，和在共同比赛时钟下取得的成绩，不是完全相同的比较对象。规则选了后一种，并不意味着它把前一种判成没有意义，也不意味着净计时会让所有起跑位置变得一样。
patch.before_en: This distinction matters because it corrects a natural intuition. A mass-participation runner may ask: I crossed the start several minutes after the gun, so why should my time begin at the gun? For that individual, net time is indeed fairer; it measures how long they actually ran. But records use the gun's clock not because it is fairer to the individual. On the contrary, it is unfair to the individual. They use it because a record requires a uniform starting point, the same for everyone. If everyone's clock began at their own crossing, position at the start would cease to matter; starting at the front and being crowded at the back would make no difference, changing part of the nature of the race. Records therefore sacrifice individual fairness for a common clock. This is another trade-off by the construct: it knows net time is fairer to individuals, but chooses the less individually fair gun clock for the uniformity of records.
patch.after_en: This distinction corrects a natural intuition. A mass-participation runner may ask why waiting should count when they cross the start minutes later. Net time more closely represents their own passage from start to finish, but does not remove congestion or extra weaving at the back. Record timing uses the gun so that performances in the same race share a starting-signal reference, rather than each runner opening a separate clock on crossing. This can be understood as a trade-off: an individual’s time covering the course and their performance on a common race clock are not quite the same object of comparison. Choosing the latter does not make the former meaningless, nor would net timing make every starting position equivalent.

echo_fields.before_zh: 所以这里又是两套账。一套是枪响的时钟，那是纪录的时钟，对所有人一视同仁，从同一声枪响开始。另一套是你自己的时钟，从你自己越过起跑线开始，那是对你个人最公平的时钟。这两套账，用的是同一套硬件，量的却是两个不同的东西。而纪录，只认第一套。
echo_fields.before_en: Here, then, are two more ledgers. One follows the gun's clock: the record clock, treating everyone alike by beginning at the same gunshot. The other follows your own clock, beginning when you cross the start line: the clock fairest to you personally. The two ledgers use the same hardware but measure different things. Records recognise only the first.

findings.reason: Official24December2002 announcement established IAAF world bests from1January2003 already requiring A/B measurement,50% separation and1m/km drop. Official1January2004 announcement says WR under the same conditions as previous world bests. Therefore not a2004invention of geometry or all earlier world bests without geometry. Distinguish informal/historical world-best usage (e.g.Benoit1983) from2003official category; keep2004WRinstitutional status and existing eligible performances continuing.

patch.before_zh: 这段历史，正好是这一篇主题的一个时间维度。世界纪录这个类别，在路跑上，不是一直存在的。它是2004年才被建立起来的。而建立它，必须先划一条线，划出赛道的丈量标准和几何标准。在这条线被划出来之前，路跑只有世界最好，一个不依赖赛道几何的，更宽松的说法。这条线一划，路跑就有了世界纪录，一个依赖赛道几何的，更严格的类别。而波士顿，因为它1897年就有的点对点身份，比这个2004年才建立的纪录架构，早了一个多世纪。
patch.after_zh: 这段历史给两套账添了时间的一层，但要把两个变化分开。路跑的“世界最好”长期有不同机构与历史记录的用法；从2003年起，国际田联正式承认的世界最好，已经要求合格丈量、百分之五十的起终点间距和每公里一米的净下降限制。2004年，合格成绩在相同条件下获得了“世界纪录”的正式地位。变的不是那一天忽然发明了几何，而是已有的可比性条件进入了一套新的纪录身份。波士顿的赛事与点对点传统都早于这套现代框架；它的历史分量，并不会因为进不了那一栏而消失。
patch.before_en: This history adds a temporal dimension to the essay's subject. The world-record category has not always existed in road running. It was established in 2004. Establishing it first required a boundary defining measurement and geometrical standards. Before that boundary, road running had world bests, a broader designation not dependent on course geometry. Once it was drawn, road running had world records, a stricter category dependent on geometry. Boston's point-to-point identity, dating from 1897, preceded this record framework, established only in 2004, by more than a century.
patch.after_en: This history adds a temporal layer to the two ledgers, but two changes must be distinguished. World best had long been used in historical records and by different organisations. From 2003, officially recognised IAAF world bests already required certified measurement, start–finish separation within 50 percent and net descent within one metre per kilometre. In 2004, eligible performances acquired formal world-record status under the same conditions. Geometry was not suddenly invented that day. Existing comparability conditions were carried into a new record status. Boston’s race and point-to-point tradition predate this modern framework, and its historical significance does not disappear because it falls outside that column.

echo_fields.before_zh: 这个用词不是新闻式的谦虚。它反映的是一个真实的机构地位。在那个时候，国际田联还没有建立那个依赖赛道丈量和几何的路跑纪录批准类别。路跑的赛道，不像一条标准的跑道那样，在几何上是可互换的，所以国际田联当时不给路跑成绩批准世界纪录，只承认世界最好。
echo_fields.before_en: This was not journalistic modesty. It reflected a real institutional status. At the time, the IAAF had not yet established the road-record ratification category dependent on course measurement and geometry. Road courses were not geometrically interchangeable in the way a standard track was, so the IAAF did not ratify their performances as world records. It recognised world bests.

echo_fields.before_zh: 这个状况，到2003年才改变。2003年，国际田联创建了标准路跑距离的官方世界纪录框架，带着丈量，赛道几何和别的批准要求。这个改变，2004年1月1日生效。已有的合格的世界最好成绩，可以成为新系统下的初始世界纪录，而不是历史从1月1日从零重启。所以一个2003年创造的成绩，当时可以被叫作世界最好，后来又成为首批官方路跑世界纪录之一。
echo_fields.before_en: That changed only in 2003, when the IAAF created an official world-record framework for standard road-running distances, with requirements for measurement, course geometry and other aspects of ratification. The change took effect on 1 January 2004. Existing eligible world bests could become the new system's initial world records, rather than history restarting from zero that day. A performance achieved in 2003 could therefore be called a world best at the time and later become one of the first official road-running world records.

echo_fields.before_zh: 世界田径必须先划一条线，才能在2004年，把路跑的世界最好，变成可以批准的世界纪录。这条线，让世界纪录这个统计类别，更可复现，更可比。一条赛道要进这个类别，必须量得准，必须几何合格，必须计时用枪声的时钟。这些要求，把那些系统性影响成绩的因素，坡度，顺风，起点终点的相对位置，都限制在了一个可控的范围里。
echo_fields.before_en: World Athletics had to draw a boundary before road-running world bests could become ratifiable world records in 2004. That boundary made the statistical category of world records more reproducible and comparable. A course entering the category must be accurately measured, geometrically eligible and timed by the gun's clock. Those requirements confine factors that systematically affect performance, including slope, tailwind and the relative positions of start and finish, within a controllable range.

findings.kind: source strict liability and consequences too completely separated
findings.reason: Two-stage violation/fault-dependent ineligibility distinction is valuable. But it is not true that every consequence waits for fault: CodeArticle9 automatically disqualifies the relevant individual in-competition result regardless of fault. Article10.5 eliminates ineligibility, not automatically every consequence. Lawson award confirms ADRV/no ineligibility, not no consequences everywhere; its sample was out-of-competition. Narrow2.7escape sanction and4.7fouryears to zero to the ban, preserving actualcase outcome. Do not falsely add disqualification to Lawson.

patch.before_zh: 条例故意把两个问题分开。第一个问题是，一次违规有没有发生。第二个问题是，这次违规该有什么后果。严格责任只回答第一个问题。它说，只要物质存在，违规就成立，这一层不问内心。但后果是另一个问题，由条例的第十条来处理，而在这一层，过错和故意，高度地相关。
patch.after_zh: 条例把两个问题分开：违规有没有发生，以及它应当产生什么后果。严格责任意味着，在前面说过的适用条件满足时，确立“存在”这一违规不必另外证明故意。但并非所有后果都等到问清过错才发生：个人项目中，与赛内检测相连的那项比赛成绩，依第九条会被自动取消。第十条处理的禁赛期限及其减免，则高度重视故意与过错。无过错可以消除禁赛期，不等于一切竞技后果都自动消失。
patch.before_en: The Code deliberately separates two questions. First, has a violation occurred? Second, what consequences should it carry? Strict liability answers only the first. It says that presence establishes the violation, without asking about the athlete's state of mind at that stage. Consequences are another question, addressed by Article 10, where fault and intention are highly relevant.
patch.after_en: The Code separates whether a violation occurred from what consequences follow. Strict liability means that, once the prerequisites already described are satisfied, establishing presence does not additionally require proof of intent. But not every consequence waits for a finding about fault: Article 9 automatically disqualifies the relevant individual result when the violation is connected with an in-competition test. Intention and fault are highly relevant to the period of ineligibility and its reduction under Article 10. No Fault can eliminate that period without automatically eliminating every competitive consequence.

echo_fields.before_zh: 看清这个两阶段的结构。第一阶段，确立违规，是严格的，不看内心。第二阶段，确定后果，恰恰要看内心。根据第十点五条，如果运动员能证明自己无过错也无疏忽，那么本来适用的禁赛期，可以被完全消除。根据第十点六条，如果运动员有过错但过错不重大，禁赛期可以减轻。
echo_fields.before_en: The two-stage structure needs to be clearly understood. The first stage, establishing the violation, is strict and does not examine intention. The second, determining consequences, does examine the athlete's state of mind. Under Article 10.5, if an athlete establishes No Fault or Negligence, the otherwise applicable period of ineligibility may be eliminated entirely. Under Article 10.6, where there is fault but it is not significant, the period may be reduced.

echo_fields.before_zh: 所以严格责任不是不看清白。它是把违规和过错，分成了两层来处理。严格的只是违规那一层。清白不清白，在后果那一层，被认真地问。说严格责任等于自动四年，是把这两层塌成了一层，是错的。
echo_fields.before_en: Strict liability therefore does not disregard innocence. It separates violation and fault into two levels. Only the violation level is strict. At the level of consequences, innocence is seriously examined. To equate strict liability with an automatic four years collapses those levels into one. It is wrong.

echo_fields.before_zh: 这里可以看到构的一个精巧的设计。它面对一个两难:如果每一个阳性都要求证明故意，那么蓄意服药的人，只要能合理地否认故意，就能逃脱，因为故意是内在的，极难证明。可如果只看物质存在，一律重罚，又会冤枉那些真正无辜的人，比如误服了污染补充剂的人。构的解法，是把这两件事拆开:在确立违规这一层，它不问故意，于是没有人能靠否认故意逃脱；在确定后果这一层，它认真地问过错，于是无辜的人有机会免责。一个不问，一个问，分在两层。
echo_fields.before_en: Here the construct has designed something ingenious. It faces a dilemma. If every positive finding requires proof of intention, deliberate users can escape whenever they can plausibly deny intent, because intention is internal and extremely difficult to prove. But imposing uniformly severe penalties on presence alone would wrong the genuinely innocent, such as athletes who inadvertently ingest contaminated supplements. The solution separates the issues. When establishing the violation, the construct does not ask about intent, so denying intent provides no escape. When determining consequences, it carefully examines fault, allowing the innocent an opportunity to escape a sanction. One stage does not ask; the other does.

echo_fields.before_zh: 这两个案子放在一起，说明了污染是怎么起作用的。它不是让阳性发现被宣布为不存在。物质存在这个事实，从来没有被推翻。污染改变的，是量刑的评估。在劳森那里，它把后果从四年消除到零；在辛普森和鲍威尔那里，它把后果从十八个月减到六个月。违规还是违规，变的是过错，变的是后果。
echo_fields.before_en: Together, these cases show how contamination operates. It does not make a positive finding disappear. Presence was never overturned. Contamination changed the assessment of the sanction. For Lawson, the consequences fell from four years to none; for Simpson and Powell, from eighteen months to six. The violation remained a violation. Fault and consequences changed.

findings.kind: source statistical spread not interval bounds
findings.reason: Original study reports6.8±2.0 years for announcement delay of the76affected medals, not medal receipt. Source accessible text did not explicitly identify the±summary as SD; do not invent that label. Say reported dispersion, not each case lies within mean±2. English existing spread already better than hard interval, preserve its sense while making non-bound explicit.

patch.before_zh: 而这项分析还给出了一个时间上的数字:从赛会结束，到宣布这些追溯的违规，平均是六点八年，上下大约两年。
patch.after_zh: 这项分析还给了一个时间数字：对这些受重检违规影响的奖牌成绩，从赛会结束到违规宣布，平均间隔是六点八年，论文以“六点八±二点零年”报告离散程度。这里的正负数不是说每个案例都落在平均值上下两年以内。
patch.before_en: The same analysis supplied a measure of delay: the mean interval between the Games and the announcement of retrospective violations was 6.8 years, with a spread of approximately two years either way.
patch.after_en: The analysis also gives a measure of delay for these affected medal results: the mean interval from the Games to announcement of the retrospective violation was 6.8 years, reported with dispersion as 6.8±2.0 years. That does not mean every case lay within two years of the mean.

findings.kind: source lack of established aggregate versus no possible reliable figure
findings.reason: Correctly separates announcement and physical medal receipt. But listing extra procedural delays does not prove no reliable global figure exists; the locatedstudy does not provide one. Scope conclusion to this study/material rather than all global datasets or statistical impossibility.

patch.before_zh: 这个六点八年，极容易被误引，所以必须说清楚它测的是什么。它测的是从赛会结束，到宣布重检违规的平均间隔。它不是从赛会到运动员拿到那块补发奖牌的间隔。这两者之间，还隔着上诉，隔着联合会调整成绩，隔着国际奥委会执委会的行动，隔着原奖牌归还或者不归还，隔着运动员自己选择的仪式。所以，没有一个可靠的全球数字，能说出一个运动员平均要等多久才能拿到那块补发的奖牌。
patch.after_zh: 这个六点八年很容易被误引，所以要说清楚：它测的是赛会结束到重检违规宣布的平均间隔，不是运动员拿到补发奖牌的等待时间。中间还可能隔着上诉、联合会调整成绩、国际奥委会执委会的决定、原奖牌的归还，以及运动员选择的仪式。这里查到的这项研究没有给出“平均多久真正收到奖牌”的全球数字，不能把六点八年挪过去回答那个问题。
patch.before_en: That 6.8-year figure is easily misquoted, so we must specify what it measures. It measures the average interval from the Games to announcement of a retesting violation. It does not measure the interval until an athlete receives a reallocated medal. Between those events may lie appeals, federation revisions of results, IOC Executive Board action, return or non-return of original medals, and the athlete's choice of ceremony. There is therefore no reliable global figure for how long, on average, athletes wait to receive reallocated medals.
patch.after_en: The 6.8-year figure is easily misquoted. It measures the interval from the Games to announcement of a retesting violation, not the wait until an athlete actually receives a reallocated medal. Appeals, federation revisions, IOC Executive Board decisions, return of original medals and the athlete’s choice of ceremony may still intervene. The study examined here supplies no global mean for actual medal receipt. Its 6.8 years cannot be transferred to answer that different question.

findings.reason: Ceremonies visibly offer belated recognition; establishing them does not prove IOC held the author’s exact counterfactual view that full repair would require only mailing. Mark the reading as author interpretation; retain distinction between symbolic repair and recreating lost originalmoment. Do not turn philosophic claim into attributed institutional confession.

patch.before_zh: 国际奥委会自己设立正式仪式这件事，恰恰说明它意识到了这一点。如果一块补发的奖牌真的能完全修复原初的错误，那么邮寄一下就够了。正因为邮寄不够，正因为一块奖牌背后那个失去的时刻无法被完全补偿，国际奥委会才要用一个仪式，至少在象征的层面上，给那个迟到的承认一点分量。仪式是对那个无法被完全修复的东西的一种承认，而不是一种修复。
patch.after_zh: 国际奥委会提供正式的补发仪式，可以被理解为对这份损失的一种回应。寄回一块金属，和让一个人重新站到公众面前，承认那是他的成绩，并不是同一件事。仪式能给迟到的承认一些分量，也可能完成一部分修复；它仍不能把原来的那一晚交回来。这是从仪式中可以读出的一层意义，不必把它说成机构已经完整表达过的唯一动机。
patch.before_en: The IOC's own creation of formal ceremonies shows its awareness of this. If a reallocated medal could fully repair the original wrong, posting it would be enough. Precisely because posting is insufficient, because the lost moment behind the medal cannot be fully compensated, the IOC uses ceremony to give belated recognition at least some symbolic weight. Ceremony acknowledges what cannot be fully repaired. It is not itself the repair.
patch.after_en: The IOC’s provision of formal reallocation ceremonies can be read as a response to that loss. Sending a piece of metal and bringing someone before a public to recognise their achievement are not the same act. Ceremony gives belated recognition some weight and may offer a measure of repair. It still cannot return the original night. That is one meaning we can read in the practice, without presenting it as the institution’s fully stated or exclusive motive.

findings.kind: source assay scope versus institutional inability to know harm
findings.reason: Earlier sections establish coercive administration, bodily changes and criminal harm through archives/testimony/courts. Ending cannot say the construct as a whole has no way to detect what happened or everylossforeverbeyondknowledge. A sample alone cannot exhaust experience or reverse harm. Preserve gravity and irreversibility, acknowledge other evidentiary/institutionalroutes rather than erase findings.

patch.before_zh: 这个构能检测出一个样本里有没有某种物质，精确到极微的浓度。它没有办法检测出，一个把物质放进不知情的人身体里的系统，对那些人做了什么。因为那个东西，不在样本里，它在别的地方，在那些被夺走了对自己身体的知情，后来用一生去弄清自己身上发生了什么的人那里。构能查的，是物质。它查不到的，是那些人失去的东西。而那些东西，和账本之外所有失去的东西一样，永远地留在了尺子量不到的地方。
patch.after_zh: 样本检测能把某种物质辨认到极微的浓度，却不能仅凭那一个读数，量尽一个不知情的人被怎样对待。档案、证词、医学与法庭，仍能查明给药和伤害，追究责任；这些工作并非无能为力。只是它们也不能把一个人失去的知情、身体自主和年月，完整地交还。那些后来用一生弄清自己身上发生了什么的人，不只是一次检测里的浓度。尺子可以把一部分事实量清，却不能用那个读数结清一个人的损失。
patch.before_en: The construct can detect whether a substance is present in a sample, down to an extremely small concentration. It cannot detect what a system that placed substances in unknowing people's bodies did to those people. That is not in the sample. It is elsewhere, with those deprived of knowledge about their own bodies, who then spent their lives trying to understand what had happened to them. The construct can test for substances. It cannot test for what those people lost. Those losses, like everything lost outside the ledger, remain forever where the ruler cannot reach.
patch.after_en: A sample test can identify a substance at an extremely low concentration. That reading alone cannot encompass how an unknowing person was treated. Archives, testimony, medicine and courts can still establish administration and harm, and pursue responsibility; those efforts are not powerless. They cannot, however, fully return lost knowledge, bodily autonomy or years of a life. People who later spent their lives understanding what had happened to them are more than a concentration in a test. The ruler can clarify some facts without settling the whole account of a person’s loss.

findings.reason: EP14 reviewedeligibility may involve a discrete SRYscreen plus continuousphysiology, not simply cuttingone continuous range. EP13 unobservableindividualcounterfactual does not mean all causaljudgement scientificallyimpossible. Intro may use compact neutralrefs rather than undo new qualifiedarguments. EN already improves Chinese innerstates to unseenotherthings; retain.

patch.before_zh: 前面几篇里，构一直在费力地判断内心的，看不见的东西。第十三篇里，它要判断一个不存在的身体会跑多快;第十四篇里，它要判断一条连续的生理线该切在哪里。那些判断都极其困难，因为它们要够到一些够不到的东西。而这一篇里，构做了一个相反的选择:对于运动员的内心状态，那个同样看不见，同样难以证明的东西，它干脆不问了。它把违规的成立，建立在一个纯粹外部的，可以客观检测的事实上，样本里有没有那个物质。
patch.after_zh: 前面几篇里，构一直费力判断那些不能直接看见的东西。第十三篇面对的是，一个身体在另一种条件下会跑多快；第十四篇面对的是，哪些身体条件应当进入比赛资格。这些问题都不能靠一个现成读数得到全部答案。这一篇的选择不同：在确立样本中禁用物质的“存在”时，它不再把证明运动员的内心状态当作必要条件。它把这一层违规，先建立在满足适用标准的外部证据上，而把故意和过错留给后面的判断。
patch.before_en: In earlier essays, the construct repeatedly struggled to judge inner states and other things that cannot be seen. In Essay 13, it had to judge how fast a nonexistent body would run; in Essay 14, where to cut a continuous physiological range. Those judgements were extraordinarily difficult because they tried to reach what could not be reached. Here the construct makes the opposite choice. Faced with an athlete's state of mind, equally invisible and difficult to prove, it simply does not ask. It establishes the violation on a purely external, objectively detectable fact: whether the substance is in the sample.
patch.after_en: Earlier essays examined judgements about things that cannot be directly seen. Essay 13 asked how a body would perform under different conditions; Essay 14 asked which bodily conditions should enter competition eligibility. No ready-made reading supplies the whole answer. Here the choice is different. When establishing the presence of a prohibited substance in a sample, the construct does not make proof of an athlete’s state of mind a necessary condition. It first establishes that violation through external evidence satisfying the applicable standards, leaving intention and fault for later judgements.
